skill.name: next-upgrade
skill.description: Guide a Next.js project upgrade using official migration guides, codemods, dependency updates, and validation checks.
skill.summary: Upgrade Next.js projects with official guides, codemods, dependency updates, and post-upgrade checks.
skill.author: vercel-labs

security_audit.summary: The skill is a normal Next.js upgrade workflow and contains no prompt injection or data-exfiltration language. The main risk is that it instructs agents to run unpinned npm and npx commands plus project scripts, which can execute third-party or repository-controlled code. The hardcoded URLs point to official Next.js documentation and are not suspicious.

remediation.suggestion: Ask for user confirmation before npx execution and prefer pinned @next/codemod versions after checking the official guide.
Resolve target versions from the migration guide and present dependency changes before installing packages.

remediation.issue: Project scripts may execute repository code
remediation.suggestion: Show the scripts that npm run build and npm run dev will execute, then request user approval.
Keep WebFetch limited to official Next.js documentation and avoid sending project source or secrets in requests.

content.value_statement: Next.js upgrades can involve breaking changes, codemods, and dependency coordination. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through official migration steps and validation checks.
actual_capabilities: Reads package.json to identify the current Next.js and React versions.
Fetches official Next.js migration and codemod documentation.
Builds an incremental upgrade path for major version changes.
Suggests relevant Next.js codemods before manual edits.
Updates Next.js, React, React DOM, and related TypeScript packages.
Runs build and development checks after migration changes.
limitations: It depends on official documentation being reachable during the session.
It cannot guarantee npm packages or project scripts are safe to execute.
It may need manual follow-up for custom routing, configuration, or APIs.
It does not replace application-specific regression testing.

use_cases.title: Plan a Version Upgrade
use_cases.description: Create a clear migration path from the current Next.js version to the requested target version.

use_cases.title: Apply Official Codemods
use_cases.description: Select relevant codemods, run them with approval, and review generated source changes.

use_cases.title: Validate Release Readiness
use_cases.description: Run post-upgrade checks and summarize remaining build, type, or runtime issues.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect Upgrade Needs
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the next-upgrade skill to inspect this repository and identify the current Next.js, React, and React DOM versions.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Major Upgrade
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning for a major version change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the next-upgrade skill to plan an incremental upgrade path to the latest stable Next.js release. Do not change files yet.

prompt_templates.title: Run Codemods With Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Apply automated migrations with controlled execution.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the next-upgrade skill to find applicable codemods, ask before running commands, then summarize every generated change.

prompt_templates.title: Complete a Complex Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the next-upgrade skill to upgrade this app, handle manual breaking changes, update dependencies, and report validation results.

output_examples.input: Upgrade this Next.js 13 application to the latest supported version.
output_examples.output: The skill reports the current dependency versions, proposes an incremental path, lists required codemods, and highlights manual migration tasks.

output_examples.input: Review this repository before running any upgrade commands.
output_examples.output: The skill provides a read-only upgrade plan, dependency impact summary, and approval points for package installs and project scripts.

output_examples.input: After migration changes, check whether the app is ready.
output_examples.output: The skill summarizes build and development check results, remaining errors, and suggested next fixes for release readiness.

best_practices: Review the proposed upgrade path before allowing package manager commands.
Commit or stash local work before running codemods or dependency updates.
Run application tests after the build succeeds.
anti_patterns: Running unpinned package commands without reading the migration plan.
Skipping manual review of codemod-generated source changes.
Treating a successful build as complete release validation.

faq.question: Does this skill upgrade every Next.js version directly?
faq.answer: No. It recommends incremental upgrades for major version jumps when the official guides require them.

faq.question: Will it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: It may propose npm, npx, build, and dev commands. Users should approve those commands before execution.

faq.question: Which documentation does it use?
faq.answer: It uses official Next.js codemod and version-specific upgrade documentation from nextjs.org.

faq.question: Can it handle TypeScript projects?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes steps for React type package updates when TypeScript types are present.

faq.question: Does it fix all breaking changes?
faq.answer: No. It guides codemods and common manual changes, but custom application behavior still needs review.

faq.question: Is it useful for monorepos?
faq.answer: Yes, but users should specify the app path and confirm the package manager and workspace layout.
